Horizon3.ai Advances AI Governance: NIST AI RMF Alignment, EU AI Act Alignment, and Customer-Facing RoPA Now Available
Published July 28, 2026
We are pleased to announce that we are now aligned with two of the most important frameworks shaping responsible AI and data governance today: the EU AI Act and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (RMF).
As part of this milestone, we have published the following resources in our Trust Center:
EU AI Act Adherence Statement — describing how our practices, processes, and controls map to the requirements of the EU AI Act.
NIST RMF Adherence Statement — describing how our practices, processes, and controls map to the requirements of NIST AI RMF.
Record of Processing Activities (RoPA) — a customer focused document describing how personal data is processed across within Horizon3 systems, which supports our customer's compliance obligations.
These publications reflect our ongoing commitment to transparency, accountability, responsible AI practices and privacy. We believe our customers deserve clear, accessible documentation of how we manage risk and protect data.
Privacy
Notice of New Sub-Processor: Elastic Security (elastic.co)
Published July 25, 2025
As part of our ongoing commitment to transparency and GDPR compliance, we are providing notice of an upcoming change to our sub-processor list.
Effective Date: July 25, 2025
Sub-Processor Added:
Name: Elastic Security (elastic.co)
Location: United States
Purpose: Elastic Security is used as our Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solution to collect, analyze, and respond to security events across our infrastructure. This supports our efforts to detect threats, monitor anomalies, and enhance overall security posture.
Data Categories: System event metadata, access logs, security audit trails, and infrastructure telemetry data. Data may include pseudonymized user identifiers for security monitoring purposes.
We have reviewed Elastic’s security, privacy, and compliance frameworks and confirmed they meet our data protection requirements under applicable laws and regulations.
If you are a customer and have any questions or concerns regarding this change, please contact us at [info@horizon3.ai].
You can view our full list of sub-processors at any time [https://trust.horizon3.ai/subprocessors\Opens in new tab].
